subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3330
title: Provides protections for a person who refuses to participate in a procedure related to abortion, physician-assisted suicide or gender-affirming treatment if the refusal is based on a person's ethical, moral or religious convictions.
headline: HB 3330 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3330 was introduced in the House on January 21, 2025.
HB 3330 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
